Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruits, eventually becoming necrotic.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.precautions: Avoid overhead irrigation, use certified disease-free seeds, and rotate crops.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedies: Apply copper-based fungicides and neem oil. Improve air circulation.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Use bactericides containing copper hydroxide or streptomycin sulfate.

Pepper__bell___healthy.symptoms: No visible disease symptoms. Leaves are green and fruits are unblemished.
Pepper__bell___healthy.precautions: Maintain good hygiene and monitor for pests.
Pepper__bell___healthy.organic_remedies: Proper watering, pruning, and compost use.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings on older leaves, yellowing of foliage.
Potato___Early_blight.precautions: Avoid overhead watering and remove infected debris.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_remedies: Apply compost tea or copper sprays.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Use fungicides like chlorothalonil or mancozeb.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Lush green foliage and undamaged tubers.
Potato___healthy.precautions: Ensure crop rotation and pest monitoring.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Dark lesions on leaves and stems, white fungal growth under leaves.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_remedies: Use copper sprays and remove infected plants.

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked lesions on leaves, stems, and fruits.
Tomato_Bacterial_spot.precautions: Avoid wet foliage, use disease-free seeds.
Tomato_Bacterial_spot.organic_remedies: Use copper-based sprays and prune affected parts.

Tomato_Early_blight.symptoms: Dark spots with concentric rings and yellowing leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.precautions: Use resistant varieties, mulch to prevent soil splash.

Tomato_healthy.symptoms: Dark green, vibrant foliage with healthy fruits.

Tomato_Late_blight.symptoms: Brown spots on leaves and stems with white fuzzy growth.
Tomato_Late_blight.precautions: Avoid high humidity, ensure spacing for air flow.
Tomato_Late_blight.organic_remedies: Remove affected leaves and apply copper sprays.
Tomato_Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Use fungicides with metalaxyl or chlorothalonil.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Yellow spots on upper leaf surface, gray mold underneath.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.organic_remedies: Apply baking soda or potassium bicarbonate solutions.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Circular spots with gray centers and dark margins on lower leaves.
Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.precautions: Avoid overhead watering and remove infected foliage.
Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.organic_remedies: Apply compost tea and neem oil.

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.symptoms: Tiny yellow or white speckles on leaves, fine webbing.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.precautions: Maintain humidity and monitor undersides of leaves.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.organic_remedies: Use insecticidal soap or neem oil.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.chemical_treatment: Use miticides like abamectin or bifenthrin.

Tomato__Target_Spot.symptoms: Small dark spots with light centers and concentric rings.
Tomato__Target_Spot.precautions: Remove plant debris and avoid overhead irrigation.
Tomato__Target_Spot.organic_remedies: Use neem oil and sulfur dust.

Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled yellow and green patches, stunted growth, leaf curling.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.cause: Tobamovirus transmitted by handling and tools.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.precautions: Avoid handling plants when wet. Disinfect tools.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic_remedies: Remove infected plants, use resistant varieties.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical_treatment: No chemical cure; only management practices.

Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.symptoms: Yellowing and curling of leaves, stunted growth.
Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.precautions: Control whitefly population and use virus-free transplants.
Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.organic_remedies: Neem oil sprays and yellow sticky traps.
